name: WEW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by the Royal Champion, then Christian Kingsworth, by mid-1996; a rival's own newsletter still billed the Royal Champion as reigning as late as March 1997, well past this record's own read window.

name: WEW International Championship
epitaph: Held by Zues, then Derranged, per a rival's own newsletter title tables three weeks apart in mid-1996.

name: WEW North American Championship
epitaph: Held by Jeremy Johnson across both surviving mid-1996 newsletter title tables, with no defense or challenger attested in this record.

name: WEW World Heavyweight Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Royal Family, then Hardcore Heaven, per a rival's own newsletter title tables three weeks apart in mid-1996; Hardcore Heaven is separately billed "(DPW, WEW)" in that year's RSPWF awards nominations.
